reasoning: On the season so far the Nuggets are the stronger team; with home court the Nuggets start about 8 points better, in a game of about 230 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Nuggets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Nuggets win 76 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 205 and 253 total points.
